items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: one time I ran into some woman by the name of Gypsy

ctx.x: So he said, 'I don't think you're used to hard work because a -- I think you'd better go and go get your time.' That's how I lost that job after working for, for four hours. They knew that I was, I was, I was not twenty-seven. I was only seventeen at the time and I have done anything -- didn't do any work. So, back to the south-side Chicago, and I walked the streets of Chicago. And one time, one time I ran into
some woman by the name of Gypsy. Well, Gypsy was in the, oh, the world's oldest profession.
